title: Restaurant Ordering
context: You are at a restaurant ready to order food.

dialogue.text: Good evening! Welcome to La Bella. Are you ready to order?

dialogue.prompt: Greet them and ask about the specials

dialogue.text: Tonight we have grilled salmon with vegetables and our famous mushroom risotto.

dialogue.prompt: Ask about ingredients or make your order

dialogue.text: Excellent choice! Would you like anything to drink with that?

dialogue.prompt: Order a drink or ask for recommendations

dialogue.text: Perfect. Your order will be ready in about 15 minutes.

title: Job Interview
context: You are in a job interview for a software developer position.

dialogue.text: Thank you for coming in today. Please, tell me a little about yourself.

dialogue.prompt: Introduce yourself and your background

dialogue.text: Interesting. What attracted you to this position?

dialogue.prompt: Explain why you want this job

dialogue.text: Can you describe a challenging project you worked on?

dialogue.prompt: Describe a project and challenges you overcame

dialogue.text: Great. Do you have any questions for us?

dialogue.prompt: Ask thoughtful questions about the role or company

title: Hotel Check-in
context: You are checking into a hotel after a long flight.

dialogue.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation?

dialogue.prompt: Confirm your reservation with your name

dialogue.text: Yes, I found your booking. A double room for 3 nights. May I see your ID please?

dialogue.prompt: Provide ID and ask about amenities

dialogue.text: Your room is 405 on the fourth floor. Breakfast is from 7 to 10 AM.

dialogue.prompt: Ask about WiFi, checkout time, or other services

dialogue.text: Here's your key card. The elevator is on your right. Enjoy your stay!

title: Doctor Appointment
context: You are visiting a doctor for a general checkup.

dialogue.text: Hello! How are you feeling today? What brings you in?

dialogue.prompt: Describe your symptoms or reason for visit

dialogue.text: I see. How long have you been experiencing this?

dialogue.prompt: Explain the duration and any changes

dialogue.text: Are you taking any medications currently?

dialogue.prompt: List any medications or say none

dialogue.text: Let me examine you. Based on what you've told me, I recommend some tests.

dialogue.prompt: Ask questions about the tests or treatment

title: Shopping for Clothes
context: You are shopping for clothes at a department store.

dialogue.text: Hi there! Can I help you find something today?

dialogue.prompt: Describe what you're looking for

dialogue.text: We have some great options. What size are you looking for?

dialogue.prompt: Tell them your size and preferences

dialogue.text: Here are a few options. The fitting room is over there if you'd like to try them on.

dialogue.prompt: Ask about colors, prices, or try something on

dialogue.text: That looks great on you! We also have matching accessories if you're interested.

title: Making a Phone Call
context: You are calling a company to inquire about their services.

dialogue.text: Thank you for calling TechSupport Inc. How may I direct your call?

dialogue.prompt: State the reason for your call

dialogue.text: I'll transfer you to the right department. Please hold.
Technical support, this is Sarah. How can I help you today?

dialogue.prompt: Explain your issue or question in detail

dialogue.text: I understand. Let me look into that for you. Can you provide your account number?

dialogue.prompt: Provide information and ask follow-up questions
